commitRule: a pressure stroke must enter gate 0, cross gates 1 and 2 in order, then leave the wash; the provisional route never persists
memoryRule: the gesture, visited bands, and gates remain exact while an untouched remote bloom gains width, fold, edge, and internal regrowth geometry; four regrowths persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch enters the first gate, crosses the next two, and exits; ArrowRight three times then Enter and the press control use the same deterministic event; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas 2D pressure strata, WebGL depth monolith, and irregular island field -> one continuous generated wash of broad bands and remote bloom forms
compositionRupture: horizontal strata, closed clasp / monolith, and loose island ecology -> a full-field vertical wash with a pressure route cutting across it and blooms embedded in the material
encounterRupture: click a patch, oppose two sites, and pass through a void -> complete an ordered three-gate pressure passage whose route disappears on release
temporalRupture: local preview, through-cut, and reciprocal drying -> a provisional gesture is erased while remote regrowth accumulates as a finite material memory
mediumRupture: generated Canvas pigment islands, WebGL volumes, and seam field -> rasterized p5.js Canvas 2D wash, broad produced bands, grain, and bloom geometry
changedRule: Pressure is not stored where the hand passes: only an ordered three-gate passage that exits the sheet can spend material, and the gesture vanishes while an untouched remote bloom is re-produced.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one dark continuous wash of nine generated bands and eight irregular blooms. A valid passage leaves the route, bands, gates, and visited site exact while a remote bloom gains real width, fold, edge, and inner regrowth geometry; four regrowths compound.
falsifier: Delete if the gesture leaves a local scar, if a gate or visited band changes, if the remote response is only colour or readout, if every passage shares one bloom, if later regrowths reset, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v048 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the remote-regrowth wash from v045-v047 or if the pressure sequence is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
